# Burkina Faso African Drum

\\n

## Burkina Faso African Drum, Djalla Wood, 330mm/13"

\\nThe Burkina Faso African Drum is made from Djalla wood which is a deep red wood with contrasting grains and colour. The rich tones are enhanced by the Australian cow skin. Cow skin is traditionally used on this African drum in Burkina Faso. \\n \\n
